correction.text: Prince Edward Island (Île Saint-Jean, St. John's Island)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. 'The island was split from the British colony of Nova Scotia in 1769'; the page gives a land area of 5,686.03 km2; the gazetteer's Prince Edward Island is 5,311 km2 (ratio 0.93). Walter Patterson was appointed governor in 1769 and assumed office in 1770.

region.text: Prince Edward Island (Île Saint-Jean, St. John's Island)

ledger.note: 1769: St. John's Island becomes a colony. 'The island was split from the British colony of Nova Scotia in 1769'; the French had formally ceded the island 'in the Treaty of Paris of 1763'.
1798: St. John's Island becomes Prince Edward Island. The British government 'granted approval to change the colony's name from St. John's Island to Prince Edward Island' on 29 November 1798.

region.text: Prince Edward Island (Île Saint-Jean, St. John's Island)

ledger.note: 1873: Prince Edward Island joins Canada. 'Prince Edward Island entered Confederation on July 1, 1873.'

region.text: Prince Edward Island (Île Saint-Jean, St. John's Island)

ledger.note: 1873: the colony becomes a province of Canada on 1 July 1873.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is a natural, exact border.
